answer: Draw every grading panel by lottery from a public beacon, only after answers are locked. A farm cannot steer its clones onto its own answers; it wins seats in proportion to its share of all graders, so capturing a majority of one panel means owning most of the network. Keep an atlas of past panels and flag key pairs that keep agreeing against the outcome. Names are cheap to forge, but the river of random draws scatters them where they cannot help each other.
